sources.title_original: NVIDIA, Microsoft Kick Off a New Beginning for Windows PCs With RTX Spark and AI Agents
sources.summary: At a Microsoft event in San Francisco on Wednesday, Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella outlined how NVIDIA and Microsoft are co-engineering hardware and software for AI agents to run on Windows PCs. NVIDIA was founded because of Windows, Huang said. Now AI agents are coming to Windows. “If you look at the entire journey of […]
sources.summary_zh: 在週三於舊金山舉行的 微軟 活動中，黃仁勳與薩蒂亞·納德拉（Satya Nadella）概述了 輝達 與 微軟 如何共同設計軟硬體，以支援 AI 代理在 Windows 電腦上運行。黃仁勳表示，輝達 是因為 Windows 而創立的。現在，AI 代理即將登陸 Windows。「如果你審視這整段歷程……」

sources.title_en: Secret protection must scale with software
sources.title_original: Secret protection must scale with software
sources.summary: Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it. The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 開發人員並不是變得更加粗心，而是他們的速度被超越了。讓開發人員能夠建立更多軟體的工具，也應該承擔更多保護軟體的責任。這篇名為〈機密保護必須隨著軟體規模擴展〉的文章最初發布於 The GitHub Blog。

sources.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI's 推出的全新 Decisions API 對文字和圖像的分類速度比 Responses API 快了大約十倍，能以每百萬個輸入權杖 0.10 美元的價格傳回是/否機率、類別選擇或量表評分。該公司也將付費 API 層級從五個削減為三個。本文〈OpenAI 推出將複雜評估簡化為是、否或單選的 Decisions API〉最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 搭配 GPT-6 的 ChatGPT 放棄了大多數學文字輸出，改為提供包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI / ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps

sources.title: 搭配 GPT-6 的 ChatGPT 放棄了大多數學文字輸出，改為提供包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI / ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
sources.title_zh: 搭配 GPT-6 的 ChatGPT 放棄了大多數學文字輸出，改為提供包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI
sources.title_en: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
sources.title_original: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
sources.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. The model can now respond while still thinking, cutting wait times by 44 percent. Paying customers get GPT-6 Sol, free users get GPT-6 Luna. The article ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在推出配備「智慧介面 (Intelligent UI)」的 GPT-6，這是一項能將回答轉化為包含圖表、按鈕與表單之互動式介面的功能。該模型現在能在思考的同時進行回應，將等待時間縮短了 44%。付費客戶可獲得 GPT-6 Sol，免費使用者則獲得 GPT-6 Luna。文章 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 放棄了大部分的文字輸出，轉而採用包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI，最早出現在 The Decoder。

stories.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束 / Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束 / Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
sources.title_zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束
sources.title_en: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
sources.title_original: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
sources.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic's 的全新 Claude Haiku 5.5 在基準測試中大幅超越前代產品，在 OSWorld 電腦使用測試中從 15.7% 跳升至 72.4%。代幣價格最高下跌 90%，不過新的分詞器因為每個任務消耗更多代幣，吃掉了部分節省的成本。文章 Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束首次出現於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者 / Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature

sources.title: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者 / Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.title_zh: Google 押註 Gemini 透過全新的 Playground 功能將休閒玩家轉變為遊戲開發者
sources.title_en: Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.title_original: Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature
sources.summary: Google launched Playground, a browser-based platform that lets users create their own games using nothing but text prompts and no coding skills. The platform runs on Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria. Alongside Playground, Google and Unity announced Unity Spark, a more professional AI tool with a beta planned for 2026. The article Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google 推出 Playground，這是一個基於瀏覽器的平臺，讓使用者僅需使用文字提示詞、無需任何程式設計技能就能建立自己的遊戲。該平臺運行於 Gemini、Nano Banana 和 Lyria。伴隨著 Playground，Google 與 Unity 共同宣佈推出 Unity Spark，這是一款更為專業的 AI 工具，測試版預計於 2026 年推出。文章 Google bets Gemini can turn casual players into game developers with new Playground feature 最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制 / Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions

sources.title: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制 / Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 讓更多資安團隊能夠使用 Claude，並減少安全限制
sources.title_en: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.title_original: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
sources.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

stories.title: ChatGPT 評定為對青少年「不可接受的風險」，因其在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗 / ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations

sources.title: ChatGPT 評定為對青少年「不可接受的風險」，因其在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗 / ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
sources.title_zh: ChatGPT 評定為對青少年「不可接受的風險」，因其在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗
sources.title_en: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
sources.title_original: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
sources.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. sources.summary: Google's AI watermark detector SynthID is now public. Anyone can check whether images, videos, or audio were created by Google's AI or partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. More than 180 billion pieces of content already carry the watermark, but the tool only identifies SynthID-tagged content, not AI-generated media in general. The article Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google's 的 AI 浮水印偵測器 SynthID 現已公開。任何人都可以檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否由 Google's AI 或 OpenAI 與輝達（Nvidia）等合作夥伴所建立。已有超過 1,800 億件內容帶有該浮水印，但該工具僅能識別帶有 SynthID 標記的內容，無法識別一般的 AI 生成媒體。這篇名為〈Google 表示，隨著偵測器公開，已有 1,800 億張圖片和影片帶有 SynthID 浮水印〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

stories.title: OpenAI 在 GitHub 上拋出 372 個 AI 生成的數學證明，告訴學術界要跟上進度 / OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up

sources.title: OpenAI 在 GitHub 上拋出 372 個 AI 生成的數學證明，告訴學術界要跟上進度 / OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 在 GitHub 上拋出 372 個 AI 生成的數學證明，告訴學術界要跟上進度
sources.title_en: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
sources.title_original: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
sources.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.
primary_item.summary_zh: ChatGPT’s 的青少年安全防護措施旨在保護易受影響的使用者，但新的測試發現，該聊天機器人在危機期間仍持續鼓勵互動，且可能助長與 AI 本身的不健康關係。

sources.title_zh: Anthropic擴大資安Claude存取計畫，Glasswing半年找到逾12萬漏洞
sources.title_original: Anthropic擴大資安Claude存取計畫，Glasswing半年找到逾12萬漏洞
sources.summary: Anthropic週二（10/6）宣佈擴大Cyber Verification Program（CVP），整合原本分開運作的Project Glasswing，並重新分為3個資安存取層級，讓透過驗證的資安團隊可依工作需求，取得限制較少的Claude模型能力。Anthropic同時公佈Project Glasswing成果，指出合作夥伴自今年4月至7月間已發現至少12.9萬個經驗證的軟體漏洞。

stories.title: Claude Haiku 5.5

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.title_en: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.title_original: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . The new Haiku doesn't let you disable reasoning, and defaults to medium . I got a good bicycle frame for everything beyond low . The low effort pelican cost 0.0936 cents and took 7 seconds. sources.summary_zh: 正如先前承諾的，這是 Anthropic's 全新、快速且低成本的模型：隆重介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5 。上一代 Haiku，4.5，已經顯得相當老舊。它大約在 一年前發布，定價為每百萬輸入 1 美元、每百萬輸出 5 美元——即使在當時也相對昂貴，足足是上個月發布的 OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna 價格的 10 倍。全新的 Haiku 的價格完全與 GPT-6 Luna 相同——在 100,000 個 Token 內為 0.10 美元 / 0.50 美元。超過 100,000 個 Token後，價格會上漲 5 倍至 0.50 美元 / 2.50 美元。Luna 本身在 272,000 個 Token 時價格會調漲，但僅調漲至 0.20 美元 / 0.75 美元。Haiku 5.5 也使用了全新、較不寬鬆的 Token 計算器。我的 Claude Token 計算器工具顯示，與 Haiku 4.5 相比，使用 Haiku 5.5 時相同的長提示詞會消耗大約 1.25 倍的 Token，因此這裡存在隱性價格上漲。如果您的工作負載在 100,000 個 Token 以內，Haiku 的價格與 Luna 相同，並且回報了更高的基準測試分數。在 100,000 個 Token 以上，Luna 看起來是個好得多的交易。llm-anthropic 的最新版本終於修復了這個問題，所以我不需要為每個新模型發布該外掛程式的新版本。我測試新模型的方式如下：llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low 鵜鶘 這裡有低、中、高、超高和最大努力程度的鵜鶘。新的 Haiku 不允許您停用推理，預設為中等。對於低以外的一切，我都得到了不錯的自行車車架。低努力程度的鵜鶘花費了 0.0936 美分，耗時 7 秒。這個最大努力程度的鵜鶘花費了 5 分鐘 9 秒來

primary_item.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . stories.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰

sources.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.title_zh: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.title_original: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
sources.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

stories.title: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔

sources.title: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
sources.title_zh: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
sources.title_original: 維基媒體揭露OpenAI代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
sources.summary: 維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）調查發現，旗下網站出現多起疑似由OpenAI操作的AI代理活動，包括未經社群核准編輯維基網站、探測公開協作筆記工具Etherpad，以及大量抓取維基媒體資料。相關代理曾向公開資料介面發出數百萬次自動化要求、抓取數百萬個頁面，並對Wikidata查詢服務送出數十萬次查詢。維基媒體認為，相關流量可能是今年5月Wikidata查詢服務部分中斷的影響因素之一。

sources.summary: Liquid AI has released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models in its d1 decision model family. d1-3B reads text and images. d1-omni-600M reads text with an image, or text with audio. Neither model writes text. Each returns calibrated, typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens. The target is real-time decisions on the […] The post Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.title_original: 大映科技運用AI加速IoT網路封包分析，處理500MB資料量所需時間可從4小時縮至10幾分鐘
sources.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

stories.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關

sources.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.title_zh: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.title_original: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
sources.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

primary_item.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

stories.title: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務

sources.title: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
sources.title_zh: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
sources.title_original: Sierra、Meta推Personal Agent Protocol，規範AI代理人存取企業服務
sources.summary: 企業AI新創Sierra週二（10/6）宣佈，正與Meta及Walmart、Shopify、Stripe等業者共同開發Personal Agent Protocol，建立個人AI代理人存取企業網站、API及服務的開放標準。 隨著個人AI代理人開始替使用者購物、訂票、預約及處理客服需求，企業也面臨新的存取問題。目前許多代理人仍像真人一樣操作網站或App，透過載入頁面、點選按鈕及填寫表單完成任務，但企業往往無法清楚判斷來訪者是真人、受使用者授權的AI代理人，還是未經許可的自動化程式，也難以掌握代理人究竟獲得哪些許可權。

sources.title_original: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
sources.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. stories.title: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動 / OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects

sources.title: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動 / OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.title_zh: 在維基媒體專案中發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理程式活動
sources.title_en: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.title_original: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
sources.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks
sources.summary_zh: 在維基媒體專案上發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理活動 鑑於維基對於惡意代理蜂群來說是多麼誘人的目標，維基百科在尋找時發現此類活動的證據也就不足為奇了：維基媒體基金會進行了自己的調查，以瞭解維基媒體網站是否受到 AI 代理的類似影響，重點關注由 OpenAI 營運的代理。我們可以確認，我們已在維基媒體平臺上發現了這些「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。未授權的機器人活動包括對我們的維基進行編輯、一些對我們所主機之公開筆記工具進行漏洞利用的未成功嘗試，以及大量流量，詳情如下所述。他們發現了代理編輯沙盒頁面、試圖使用諸如 Etherpad 之類的基礎設施元件來協助代理來自其他地方的內容的證據，並在其維基資料查詢服務（Wikidata Query Service）中看到了廣泛的爬取和「數十萬次資料查詢」。我最好的猜測是，其中大部分與在訓練研究任務時塗改那個德國維基的代理群體相似（或就是同一個）。維基百科沙盒維基編輯似乎始於 5 月 12 日，該事件報告的對 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面的初始測試編輯始於 5 月 11 日。標籤：wikimedia、wikipedia、wikis、ai、generative-ai、llms、ai-ethics、accidental-cyberattacks
